name: Andy Rowland
career_history: Preconstruction Manager at Layton Construction, 3/2024 to present; Cost Engineer at Amazon, 3/2022 to 3/2024; Construction Estimator at Layton Construction, 10/2016 to 3/2022; Construction Estimator at Sure Steel, 3/2012 to 10/2016; Field Engineer at Wasatch Regional Builders, 1/2010 to 3/2012
education: Bachelor of Science (Construction Management), Commercial Construction, Brigham Young University - Idaho, 2005 to 2010
biography: With over 11 years of experience in the construction industry, I am a cost engineer at Amazon, where I manage the project bidding and estimation process for complex and large-scale projects. I have a LEED Green Associate credential and a domain expertise in construction cost and value engineering, especially for structural steel. I use my skills in project management, data analysis, and communication to collaborate with multiple stakeholders, such as contractors, architects, engineers, and clients, and deliver accurate and timely cost estimates that align with the project scope, schedule, and quality. I am passionate about creating sustainable and innovative solutions that optimize the resources, efficiency, and performance of the projects, while minimizing the environmental impact and maximizing the value for the customers. I am motivated by the mission and culture of Amazon, and I strive to bring diverse perspectives and experiences to the team.
